page_title: MAL 1-0 GRA | Mallorca v Granada CF 16/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+3' Carlos Neva goes off the pitch and Theodor Corbeanu (Granada CF) comes on.
90+3' Ignasi Miquel (Granada CF) commits a rough challenge and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle for a foul.
90+1' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Facundo Pellistri (Granada CF) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
88' Abdon Prats (Mallorca) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.

85' 1 - 0 Goal! The ball is swung into the box from the resulting corner kick and finds Antonio Raillo (Mallorca), who jumps highest and tries his luck with a header from around the penalty spot. His effort is both strong and precise enough to go into the top left corner. The score is 1:0.
85' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
84' Alexander Medina has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Antonio Puertas (Granada CF) replacing Kamil Jozwiak.
84' Substitution. Bruno Mendez makes his way off the pitch and Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF) comes on as his replacement.

84' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the right post is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca have been awarded a corner kick.
84' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

84' Nemanja Radonjic (Mallorca) connects with a precise cross inside the goalmouth and shoots. One of the defending players reacts in time and clears the ball to safety. The linesman points to the corner flag, Mallorca are going to take it.
82' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
82' Here is a change. Toni Lato is going off and Javier Aguirre gives the last tactical orders to Jaume Costa (Mallorca).
82' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Sergi Darder (Mallorca) will replace Daniel Rodriguez.

81' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. Some classy goalkeeping by Augusto Batalla stops the ball out of the bottom right corner. Mallorca will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
81' Nemanja Radonjic (Mallorca) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Augusto Batalla easily deals with the threat.
79' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

79' What a great chance for Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header right under the bar, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save. Mallorca have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
79' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) will take a corner kick.

79' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The ball goes behind for a corner. Mallorca will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
75' The ball rebounds to Abdon Prats (Mallorca) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he bends the ball well wide of the left post.
75' The free kick from close range, taken by Mallorca, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

75' The referee blows his whistle after Bruno Mendez (Granada CF) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball. Free kick. Mallorca will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
72' Alexander Medina has decided to make a change. Matias Arezo (Granada CF) replaces Myrto Uzuni.
72' Alexander Medina prepares a substitution. Gonzalo Villar is replaced by Martin Hongla (Granada CF).
71' Toni Lato (Mallorca) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
68' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Cyle Larin walks off the pitch to be replaced by Abdon Prats (Mallorca).
66' Ignasi Miquel (Granada CF) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
65' The ball is out of play. Granada CF will have a chance to score from a corner.

65' What a save from Predrag Rajkovic! Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out. The referee signals a corner kick to Granada CF.
64' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the roof of the net. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Augusto Batalla makes a comfortable save.
63' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Mallorca.
61' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
59' Today's match ends for Antonio Sanchez who will be replaced by Nemanja Radonjic (Mallorca).
56' Augusto Batalla (Granada CF) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
54' What a big chance! Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar.
54' Half-chance! Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) plays a pass into the box, but Augusto Batalla reacts well to snuff out the attack.
51' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
49' Wonderful pass from Cyle Larin (Mallorca) for Vedat Muriqi, but they can't profit from it as Augusto Batalla comes off his line to collect.
49' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
46' Javier Aguirre has made a change at the break. Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) has come on in place of Jose Copete.
46' The second half has just started.
45+1' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.

45' What a chance that is! Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the right post.
44' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
41' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Matija Nastasic (Mallorca) was quite harsh and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
40' Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the bottom right corner, but Predrag Rajkovic is equal to it and makes an easy save.
34' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
32' A quickly taken corner by Granada CF.
32' Kamil Jozwiak (Granada CF) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Good work from Granada CF as they win a corner.
28' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
26' Dangerous play by Kamil Jozwiak (Granada CF). Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle for a foul.
25' The corner is swung in but Mallorca can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

25' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the roof of the net. Augusto Batalla has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save. It will be a corner kick for Mallorca.
23' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea had an easy-decision to make.
22' Half-chance! Cyle Larin (Mallorca) plays a pass into the box, but Augusto Batalla reacts well to snuff out the attack.
20' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
18' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea no option but to blow his whistle.
16' Jose Copete (Mallorca) didn't manage to convert the resulting corner kick into a goal. He produced a header from a dangerous position inside the box, but he sent it well over the bar.
16' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) will deliver the corner kick.
16' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. The linesman makes the right call and Mallorca will have a corner.
13' Granada CF are seeing far more of the ball now.
11' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar.
10' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows for a foul after Bruno Mendez (Granada CF) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
7' The referee blows his whistle as Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) was too aggressive in his challenge.
6' Jose Copete (Mallorca) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
4' Mallorca can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
3' Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Mallorca force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
2' Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF) makes a rough challenge and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Mallorca will kick-off.
Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea will referee today's match.
